scripts.build: esbuild teste/demo/app.tsx --bundle --format=esm --jsx=automatic --outfile=teste/demo/app.js --log-level=warning && esbuild teste/rn/web-entry.tsx --bundle --format=esm --jsx=automatic --outfile=teste/rn/app.js --alias:react-native=react-native-web --define:__DEV__=false --define:process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"' --define:global=globalThis --resolve-extensions=.web.tsx,.web.ts,.web.js,.tsx,.ts,.js --loader:.js=jsx --log-level=warning && esbuild teste/prototipo/forma.ts --bundle --format=iife --outfile=teste/prototipo/forma.js --log-level=warning
scripts.unit: node --test teste/core.test.ts teste/tokens.test.ts teste/estados.test.ts teste/formato.test.ts teste/movimento.test.ts
scripts.e2e: for a in web rn; do for l in 1280 800 390; do ALVO=$a LARGURA=$l node teste/e2e.mjs || exit 1; done; done
scripts.verificar: npm run -s build && npm run -s unit && npm run -s pwa && npm run -s auditor && npm run -s espaco && npm run -s vitrine && npm run -s e2e && npm run -s movimento && npm run prototipo
